subject: [PATCH v3 00/11] mm: PMD-level swap entries for anonymous THPs

2026-07-09.patch_summary: This patch series introduces a new feature to Linux kernel called PMD-level swap entries for anonymous THPs (Transparent Huge Pages). When a PMD-mapped anonymous THP is swapped out, the current implementation splits it into PTE-level swap entries. This patch series changes this behavior so that a single PMD-level swap entry is created instead, allowing the huge mapping to survive the swap round-trip and be restored directly on swap-in without needing khugepaged to collapse the range later. The PMD swap entry is a compact page-table encoding for HPAGE_PMD_NR consecutive swap slots, and its handling is designed to work seamlessly with existing kernel features like zswap and khugepaged.
